translations.web: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
translations.bsb: I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.
translations.kjv: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
